messages.content: "你能幫我計劃我的旅行嗎？我需要在巴黎預訂一間酒店房間，住5晚。我偏好豪華房間，並希望加上早餐和水療服務。之後，我需要在巴黎租一輛車，租期為7天。我偏好SUV，並且我會在機場取車。然後，我需要在羅馬預訂另一間酒店房間，住3晚。我偏好套房，並希望加上機場接送服務。最後，我需要在羅馬租一輛車，租期為5天。我偏好緊湊型的轎車，並且我會在酒店取車。"

function.name: car_rental

days.description: Number of days for which to rent the car.

car_type.description: Type of the car to rent.

pick_up.description: Location of where to pick up the car. Default is 'airport' if not specified.

function.name: hotel_book
function.description: Book a hotel room given the location, room type, and number of nights and additional services Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

roomType.description: Type of the room to be booked.

nights.description: Number of nights to book the room for.

items.description: Additonal services that can be booked.

additional_services.description: Additional services to be added. Default is not use it if not specified.
